usage: Used as a noun meaning the work or field of accounting; common in office, finance, and business settings.
Often appears in phrases like 會計部, 會計師, and 會計工作; the bare word 會計 can mean either the subject or the job.
Neutral and standard in Hong Kong Cantonese; suitable for both workplace conversation and formal writing.
Learner tip: don’t confuse 會計 with 計數; 會計 is the profession/system, while 計數 is the act of counting or calculating.
